verification.method: Actual local Python unittest run; explicit source module loading under python -I -B; Windows temporary synthetic journals only.
verification.claim_limit: These witnesses do not establish cloud safety, external authentication, provider cost bounds, physical filesystem latency or cloud exactly-once execution.

input_reads: Frozen v4 budget/runner and named native Opus v4 audit only; production aggregate hash-only; own new v5 sources and temporary fixtures.
environment_tests: Synthetic sentinel dictionary only; no os.environ access or credential/config reads. Standard-library temporary directory selection used.

budget_guard.recompute: Under the same OS transaction as start_once and child claim: base incurred + all observed actual + remaining unsettled holds, across every experiment ID; compare all three ceilings, all actual-over-reservation rows and latched budget/ceiling violations.
budget_guard.violation_policy: Persist breach hold before denial where filesystem works. Settlement latches every detected violation. No reconciliation/reset API or self-authenticated grant exists; genuine external reconciliation is required before a future reviewed implementation could resume.
budget_guard.unknown_policy: Unknown app creation or spawn keeps full aggregate exposure, active slot, nonce and lifetime count; no uncertain retries.

duration.transport_cutoff: hard deadline minus 6 finalization seconds minus 10 slack seconds
duration.finalization_cutoff: hard deadline minus 10 slack seconds; journal operation window at most 6 seconds
duration.journal_lock_policy: Runner passes the remaining absolute wall and monotonic phase deadline into every runtime journal transaction. Direct child claim/ID/finalize APIs inherit receipt cutoffs. Every lock retry/sleep is clipped to the remaining deadline.
duration.physical_limit: Python cannot interrupt or hard-bound filesystem open/read/write/flush/fsync/replace/unlink or OS lock/unlock latency. Checks before and after detect overrun; they do not guarantee a durable record by the deadline. fsync of the temporary file is not a directory fsync, rollback-proof storage or a power-loss guarantee.
duration.replace_uncertainty: A starting record may persist before replace returns late and the caller receives an exception. The active record and attempt count hold; no launch retry is authorized.

restart_policy.restart_read_limit: A newly constructed reader can accept a coherent old journal; there is no independent persistent monotonic witness.
restart_policy.restart_mutations: Denied unless this instance initialized a genuinely new journal. Existing-journal writer resume and external reconciliation are deliberately unimplemented.
restart_policy.security_limit: Python caller identity, filesystem ownership/ACLs and authenticated external checkpoints remain deployment obligations; local attributes/hashes cannot defend against malicious same-process code.

isolation: Launch/cancel/list command construction shares a minimal Windows OS allowlist, explicit reviewed PATH and pinned MODAL_PROFILE. No token, FREYA/ZEP/LLM/OTHER, proxy, PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME passthrough. Absolute pinned Python -I -S -B and exact two-file reviewed staging cwd are validated in temp fixtures; no commands executed.
stop_policy: Synthetic inherited listing shape only. Duplicate/conflicting stopped/running listings, unknown shape, missing IDs, stale/future context, missing independently authenticated all-resource provider evidence or CLI exit0 alone cannot establish real stop. Finally persists unknown when possible, otherwise existing starting/claimed record holds.
blockers: No reviewed live transport; both live entrypoints always reject.
No independent live guardian demonstrated or armed.
No authenticated parent GPU/cloud grant, provider identity, rate ceilings, enforcement or stop/billing evidence. Caller-supplied exact hashes only bind bytes and test fixtures have zero authority.
No real qualification-benefit or authenticated reviewed TRAIN/dev/no-holdout source admission for cloud execution inspected; no new data or DEV reads were performed.
No externally trusted rollback checkpoint or reconciliation/resume protocol.

Local Windows OS lock is one-parent/one-host only; OneDrive journal paths rejected. Atomic replace is not distributed CAS or exactly-once cloud creation. No provider idempotency contract, uncertain retry, cron, services, minimum containers or automatic retries.
handoff: Parent reviews v5 source hashes and tests. Real transport remains disabled even if a new exact hash is supplied. CPU-only authorization is never GPU permission; guardian and authenticated parent/provider evidence are unresolved blockers. Actual model remains NOFIT and this task initiated zero GPU spend.
